log.msg: decision: the switch's home is ext/Ask/edit.js (edit/set_edit/on_edit), not core/App. core/App may not import ext or dev (framework/readme.md, dev/doc/decisions.md: 'core never imports ext'), and App has no page-level render seam most controls could read anyway. ext already reaches into dev/Socket (Ask.js, Saver/FileSaver.js do this today) and dev/DevBar already imports ext, so ext/Ask/edit.js is reachable from every direction that needs it with zero new import-direction violations. Alternative written into doc/decisions.md.

assign.now: converting the 7 files with their own Socket.disabled/writable() check to import edit() from ext/Ask/edit.js

log.msg: converted: 7 files with their own gate (Ask.js available()+3 throw guards, layouts/browse/verdicts.js writable(), paging/make/real.js refusal(), paging/make/made.js write()+store_for(), ext/Saver/FileSaver.js write()+delete(), ext/AITask/decisions.js writable, ext/AITask/rank.js writable) now call edit() from the new ext/Ask/edit.js. 7 consumer sites (reply.js, page.js, chat.js x2, AITask/compose.js, DesignTool/vision.js, DesignTool/vision/browse.js) needed zero changes: they already call Ask.available(), which now delegates. Left untouched, on purpose: ext/JSONL/live.js's Socket.singleton().disabled (a read-only live-vs-static data loading fallback, not an editor control); imagine/cms/json, imagine/importance, imagine/design/lists carry the identical writable() pattern but are outside the rg fence this task was scoped to -- named in doc/decisions.md as the same conversion, not yet done. Added the Edit checkbox to DevBar's head line next to Block; it calls set_edit() then location.reload() since every control decides render at construction time.

assign.now: step 4 — private server on 8136, crawl with edit toggled off then on

decision.about: Where does the one edit/production switch live — a property on core/App, or a small ext module?

options.why: One property on the thing every page already has (this.app), no new import for a page to reach it.

Every editor control already reaches into dev/Socket from ext or deeper (Ask.js, Saver/FileSaver.js do this today), and core is documented as never importing ext — framework/readme.md's core never imports them, dev/doc/decisions.md's core never imports ext. Putting the switch on App would need App to import Socket, which nothing in core does today, to serve controls that mostly live in ext/ and layouts/ anyway.

decision.because: Keeps the existing import direction (ext and dev already depend on dev/Socket; core never has), and every one of the six named controls (Ask, browse verdicts, Decisions tab, rank grips, reply/mic, Make's writes) is ext/ or a page, never core — none of them needed App at all.

log.msg: verified on private server :8136, headless Playwright, 1280 wide, all four crawl pages (day dashboard, /layouts/browse/, /imagine/paging/make/, this task's own Decisions tab): edit off = 0 controls drawn, 0 console/network errors across all four; edit on = reply+mic buttons return (27-28, one pair per ask/task card), a rank grip returns on the task page. Drilled into one browse item and one decision row (both collapsed by default, so the top-level crawl alone reads 0/0): Approve/Improve go 0 buttons (off) to 2 (on) in both the browse verdicts UI and the Decisions tab. Make's write path verified visually: the status pill reads 'Read from the files' (LocalStore, edit off) vs 'On disk... under made/' (FileStore, edit on) with the identical page state otherwise. One transient finding: an early crawl caught 26 404s on /layouts/browse/ for images/page.js under imagine/design/layout/ -- re-ran clean a few minutes later with 0 errors; a concurrent minion elsewhere in this shared tree was mid-move of that content (git status shows public/layouts/browse/ itself is untracked/new, made by another agent), unrelated to this task's files and outside this fence to chase.

documentation pass done: ext/Ask/doc/decisions.md gets a new dated section (the switch, what it replaces, the app.edit-vs-ext/Ask/edit.js decision table, the roles paragraph); ext/Ask/readme.md gets the 'this is where the switch lives' line; ext/Ask/page.js's localhost-only demo line now mentions the rail checkbox; layouts/browse/readme.md, imagine/paging/make/readme.md, ext/Saver/readme.md, ext/AITask/readme.md, dev/DevBar/readme.md each get one Watch-out line naming the switch. Verified headless at 1600: all seven touched doc/readme pages load with zero console errors and zero .md-error; screenshotted the new decisions.md section and its table rendering correctly.

assign.outcome:
**One switch, `edit()`, now decides whether the site shows its editor controls.** It lives in `ext/Ask/edit.js` — true when the dev socket is live AND the dev rail's new "edit" checkbox is on (default on, remembered); false otherwise. Seven files that each ran their own copy of `!Socket.singleton().disabled` (`ext/Ask/Ask.js`'s `available()`, `layouts/browse/verdicts.js`, `imagine/paging/make/real.js` + `made.js`, `ext/Saver/FileSaver.js`, `ext/AITask/decisions.js`, `ext/AITask/rank.js`) now call `edit()` instead — 7 checks collapsed to 1. Seven more call sites (reply, chat, DesignTool's vision tool, AITask's compose box) needed zero changes because they already went through `Ask.available()`.

**Proof, headless at 1280 on a private server:** edit off draws zero of the six named controls (verdict buttons, Decisions-tab Approve/Improve, rank grips, reply/mic, Make's writes) with zero console or network errors across four pages; edit on brings every count back. Make's own status pill visibly flips between "Read from the files" (edit off) and "On disk … under made/" (edit on) with nothing else on the page changing.

![the dev rail's block and edit checkboxes, reply/mic buttons visible under each card](/framework/ai/2026-09-18/edit-mode/rail-open.png)

**The roles line.** A separate program, `/imagine/platform/`, already decided a full sign-in system for a *different*, future Cloudflare-Workers site: six roles (owner, admin, topic founder, moderator, member, anonymous) and two providers (GitHub, Google), checked through one `can(user, action, url)` function — [`/imagine/platform/decisions/identity.md`](/imagine/platform/decisions/identity.md), §33. None of it is wired into this static site. For `edit()` to read a signed-in role instead of the socket: (1) the owner registers an OAuth app with GitHub and Google, ~15 minutes — the first blocker named in [`ai/2026-09-18/memery-scout/report.md`](/framework/ai/2026-09-18/memery-scout/); (2) the Workers-side identity stack from that decision record gets built; (3) `edit()` becomes an OR (`!Socket.singleton().disabled || can(user, "edit", url)`), so localhost keeps today's behaviour and a signed-in moderator gets it on the deployed site too. Full paragraph: [`doc/decisions.md`](/framework/ext/Ask/doc/decisions/).

**Left deliberately:** `imagine/cms/json`, `imagine/importance` and `imagine/design/lists` carry the identical `writable() = !Socket.singleton().disabled` pattern but sit outside the `rg` this brief scoped the fence to — named in `doc/decisions.md` as the same conversion, not yet done. `ext/JSONL/live.js`'s socket check is untouched on purpose: it's a read-only live-vs-static data loader, not an editor control.
